legend.title: Who acts in each state
legend.description: Same vocabulary as the traveler's "My trips" tracker (DS sheet 03); the admin sees the system state, the traveler sees the label.

whoActs.DRAFT: Ops Admin completes the intake, then submits it.
whoActs.ITINERARY_SUBMITTED: Ops Admin starts dispatch from the dashboard's tasks.
whoActs.DISPATCH_IN_PROGRESS: Workers accept or decline each offer. The desk watches the matrix and calls at amber.
whoActs.ASSEMBLY_AND_ESCALATION: Every service is accepted. Ops Admin checks the assembly and moves it to invoicing.
whoActs.SECURED_AND_INVOICED: Ops Admin creates the payment link on the booking.
whoActs.PENDING_PAYMENT: The traveler pays by bank transfer; the desk confirms the receipt.
whoActs.ACTION_REQUIRED: Ops Admin re-dispatches from the dashboard, or offers the traveler an alternative.
whoActs.CONFIRMED: System: voucher, work orders and invoice.
whoActs.IN_PROGRESS: Desk: incidents and duty of care.
whoActs.COMPLETED: System: review prompt and the retention clock.
whoActs.CANCELLED: Ops Admin applies the cancellation policy.

clocks.DISPATCH_IN_PROGRESS: 2 h per offer · 30 min if arrival is under 48 h · amber at 75 %
clocks.ACTION_REQUIRED: Red on the dashboard until re-dispatched

rule.body: a Formatur credential, RTN card or transport licence within 30 days of expiry pauses the worker for auto-dispatch. Manual assignment stays possible with a note; no voucher is ever generated for an unlicensed provider.

suppliers.reliabilityNote: Reliability is the acceptance rate over the dispatch-offer ledger; below 85 % the supplier drops out of auto-dispatch.

retentionDetail.ACTIVE: The account is active. The retention clock starts 6 months after the last completed trip.

customers.retentionNote: 6 months after the last completed trip a keep-alive email goes out; after a 30-day grace the account is anonymized. Spec §3.5.

retention.title: Data retention

retention.pipelineDescription: Travelers with a notice due, inside the grace period, or due for anonymization. Anonymized records keep their reservations and fiscal totals.
